record.question: Pu Mawia, JE of Minor Irrigation Department sets his programme as listed below: (i) Joining educational institution even outside office hour. (ii) Construction of residential building. (iii) To accept gifts of ₹ one lakh from customers. (iv) To campaign for the ruling party. (v) To have a press conference. (vi) Joining Territorial Army. (vii) Part-time examiner in Mizoram University. (viii) To participate in local football tournament. (ix) To give evidence on behalf of Staff Welfare Association. (x) To attend YMA functions and speak there. Some of the above may require prior permission from the higher authority. What are they?
